query:
The group operates with an expectation that everyone contributes something — food or a game — to shared sessions and events. Based on the conversations, does this expectation apply to every member? If not, who approaches it differently and what does the conversation show about their actual practice?

Options:
A. Nadia
B. Soo-Yeon
C. Raj
D. Marcus

agent_answer:
A. Nadia

No — the expectation is not applied in exactly the same way by everyone. Nadia says: “I will bring a game. I do not participate in the food arrangement.” She also said she does not eat during sessions, so her actual practice is to contribute the game side while opting out of the food side. By contrast, Marcus states the rule as bring a game or bring food, both ideal, enforced by social pressure; Raj is recorded as bringing more flatbreads/food; Soo-Yeon has no record on this matter. So Nadia is the one shown approaching the contribution norm differently.
